verdict.rationale: Paddle runs some fixed processes on its own, such as recurring billing, automatic transaction creation and failed-payment retries. Payment Recovery lets merchants tune that one dunning process, but the evidence shows no general way to set up custom automations that run unattended. The MCP server supports interactive, on-demand agent sessions rather than scheduled or background workflows. Webhooks, the API and AWS-driven key rotation are building blocks or host-platform features, not an automation capability of Paddle itself.
